original_requirement.title: Preserve Windows and Unix transport guarantees
original_requirement.acceptance: Test DACL/owner/SYSTEM rules, loopback authentication, exact package process, Unix private paths, permissions and peer identity.
original_requirement.section_gate: Begin only if post-optimization profiles justify added protocol complexity.
